purpose: Drei neue abgesottene Cenyric für das Leben auf hoher See in gelassenen Posen
userRequirements: Abgesottener und passend zum Leben auf hoher See

variants.title: 1 · Der Deckveteran
variants.idea: Breit gebauter, kupferoranger Kater mit kantigem Kopf und ruhigem Sitz; abgeklärter grüner Blick.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new individual Cenyric ship cat companion portrait for Aleria, aboard the medieval seagoing cog Tiefenwyrm. ONE cat only, a distinct new design.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Primary request: a TOUGH, HARDENED, SALT-WEATHERED domestic ship cat who has spent years on the HIGH SEAS, in a completely CALM, RELAXED, STATIONARY pose. A seasoned seafarer's animal companion with quiet confidence and an unbothered, stoic demeanor. Robust healthy weight, strong mature feline muzzle, smaller narrowed almond eyes, coarse slightly wind-ruffled fur, long whiskers. Looks capable and experienced, never pitiful. Closed mouth, relaxed ears, a composed level gaze, no smile. The character feels grounded and practical, rather than cute or glamorous.
Breed invariants: clearly ORANGE GINGER TABBY with darker ORANGE tiger markings, a broad WHITE BELLY and white lower chest. The orange coat has naturally weather-faded lighter tips but must remain orange, not gray or brown. The white belly and underside must be visible in the composition. Natural feline anatomy with exactly four legs, healthy domestic cat proportions, all ears, paws and the full tail safely inside frame.
Art/composition: one complete cat large in foreground, occupying about 70–75 percent of a 2:3 vertical portrait. Clear anime contours and restrained CEL SHADING, simple stylized fur masses rather than rendered individual hairs. The pose is seated or lying, still and comfortably settled. No action at all: no jumping, running, playing, balancing or paw raised mid-step. The background is a restrained, weathered wooden ship deck with ONE relevant simple prop, distant OPEN OCEAN to the horizon and sparse rigging. No land, castle or harbor. Soft maritime daylight with muted slate-blue sea contrasts with the orange coat; calm atmosphere, no storm spectacle.
Avoid: big round kitten eyes, adorable baby face, skinny frail body, fashionable showcat grooming, joyful grin, smug comedy expression, human facial anatomy, giant lion mane, cloudy eye copied from the previous old cat, wounds or blood, sad or exhausted look, matted filthy neglected fur. No costume, collar, bandana, eyepatch, hat, clothes, weapon, people, extra cats, text, lettering, watermark, panel, frame or collage. No photorealism, 3D, painterly watercolor, realistic surface textures.
Individual 1 — THE DECK VETERAN: a mature male domestic cat with broad muscular shoulders, a compact strong body, a SQUARE broad head, blunt muzzle and heavy mature tomcat cheeks. Short dense COARSE fur, no long mane, a few small jagged tufts at the cheeks and shoulder blades. Deep COPPER-ORANGE tabby with broad darker orange TIGER STRIPES, faded pale ginger at the fur tips; WHITE chin, chest and broad belly, sturdy white front socks. One small old HEALED NOTCH at the outer ear edge, no fresh wound. Two small clear muted OLIVE-GREEN eyes with an unbothered steady gaze.
Pose: completely still, seated solidly on the wooden deck beside a low plain timber bollard, hindquarters heavy and comfortably settled, both strong forelegs vertical and forepaws resting firmly on deck. Tail rests around the outside of the paws in a relaxed curve. Three-quarter front view showing the white chest and belly. Head held level, chin subtly raised, ears relaxed outward, closed mouth. Calm, stolid, tough and utterly at home at sea. Full body with margins, a broad blue-gray open sea behind and one simple timber bollard only.
